changes.comment: The hosting application can now fully control outgoing map-layer requests: MapLayerFormatRegistry.addMapLayerRequestListener registers listeners that mutate each request's headers and query parameters (e.g. inject an Authorization header for services behind an authenticating proxy), and addMapLayerResponseListener registers listeners that classify failures using their protocol's own convention. Applies to tiles, tooltips, capabilities, service metadata and source validation across all map-layer formats; requests shaped by a listener registered with injectsCredentials follow the trusted-origins redirect policy, never trigger SSO retries, and are classified as authentication failures on HTTP 401/403 by default; URL-keyed metadata caches are bypassed while request listeners are registered. Also fixed: WMS/WMTS GetCapabilities requests issued when a layer initializes now include the layer's custom query parameters, matching source validation.
